## UX hierarchy impact

- [ ] I identified which level(s) this changes: 0 Overview / 1 Scene / 2 Topic / 3 Source summary / 4 Original source.
- [ ] The current level remains visually clear.
- [ ] Important links reveal the destination level before click.
- [ ] External links remain visually distinct from internal navigation.
- [ ] The homepage/scene reading path is not becoming database-first.
- [ ] Source pages still provide an in-site summary before the external original.
- [ ] If this intentionally changes a UX invariant, I appended a decision to `docs/UX_DECISIONS.md` and updated `AGENTS.md`.
